title: A constructive ATLAS of finite simple groups in Lean
summary: We present a constructive atlas of finite simple groups with proofs of their orders, simplicity, and structural properties. The eight completed families are cyclic groups of prime order, alternating groups, the classical series $A_r(q)$, $B_r(q)$, $C_r(q)$, $D_r(q)$, and the exceptional series $G_2(q)$ and the small Ree groups $ {}^2G_2(3^{2m+1})$, $m\geq1$. The fifteen sporadic entries are $M_{11}$, $M_{12}$, $M_{22}$, $M_{23}$, $M_{24}$, $\mathrm{Co}_1$, $\mathrm{Co}_2$, $\mathrm{Co}_3$, $\mathrm{McL}$, $\mathrm{HS}$, $\mathrm{Suz}$, $J_2$, and $\mathrm{Fi}_{22}$, $\mathrm{Fi}_{23}$,…
